    Settings & help

    Compare stations

    Choose an area and press Refresh area to check every station there, within your remaining budget. There is no waiting period between different stations. Choose 5 oldest checks for unchecked stations first, then the oldest readings. Open a station for Refresh this station.

    The main number is the continuous slow road stretch reaching a mapped station access. We follow up to 200 m of incoming road, using OpenStreetMap service-road connections and TomTom traffic in the matching direction. A blue A marks the access when you select a station. These entrances are map-derived and have not been checked on site; turn restrictions may be missing.

    Slow means below 70% of free-flow speed. Red is 35% or less; orange is above 35% but below 70%; green is 70–100%; dark means a reported road closure. Bold lines show matched incoming approaches; faint lines show wider road context. A faster stretch ends the continuous measurement. Missing data stops it too, with an explicit coverage warning.

    200+ m means the slow stretch reaches the measurement limit and could extend farther. Zero means no slowdown reaches the mapped access in this reading. It does not mean there is no petrol queue. Where several approaches are mapped, the main number is the longest of them; expand the station details to see each direction.

    Only fresh readings with full coverage of every mapped 200 m approach enter the comparison. Shorter slow stretches come first, then less congested distance; reported road closures rank last. Readings capped at 200+ m tie. Unmapped entrances and partial coverage stay visible but are excluded. Nearby-road percentages are secondary context and never affect the ranking.

    Motorcycle petrol waiting times remain unknown. The traffic feed does not separate a bike queue from cars, passing traffic or a junction queue, and does not measure pump service, forecourt queues or fuel stock.

    The catalogue has 293 mapped fuel locations, including smaller retailers. Only some have an identifiable mapped access; the area count states how many. Areas overlap neighbourhood boundaries and coverage is not exhaustive.

    Opening status & fuel

    Listed closed · unverified comes from a listing, not a visit. Crisis opening hours may differ. Listings never exclude a station or override its traffic ranking. Road closures describe roads, not petrol station opening.

    Opening and fuel availability remain unconfirmed without a recent firsthand report. Traffic checks never renew opening-report timestamps.

    Refresh limits & owner access

    Only the verified GitHub owner Arthur-Freedom can request traffic. The TomTom key stays on the server and is never sent to browsers.

    The server permits 50 station checks per Bali day and 900 per month, shared across devices. Failed attempts count. Each station uses at most four traffic tiles, giving a maximum of 200 tile requests per day and 3,600 per month through this app. Nearby stations share tiles within a batch where possible.

    The same station has a 15-minute cooldown; other stations can be checked immediately. This countdown is a refresh limit, not a petrol waiting time. Optional repeat checks run every 15 minutes while this tab is visible and stop on errors or a changed area/search/refresh choice.

    Page views, signing in and moving the map do not call TomTom. The app no longer loads a paid Google basemap or calls Google Routes. Results exist only in this page’s memory. The provider may impose its own account or evaluation limits.

    Freshness & changes over time

    Colours and comparison update together when you refresh. After 15 minutes, readings leave the current comparison but stay visible in the open tab with their original date and time. Dashed coloured roads show outdated readings. A refresh limit or a failed check does not erase the last successful measurement. The displayed time is when we queried TomTom, not a guaranteed observation time for each road.

    A second comparable check in the same tab can show whether the slow stretch grew, shrank or stayed similar. It must use the same mapped approaches, full coverage and a gap of 14–45 minutes. Changes under 20 m are treated as similar. Two readings at the 200 m limit cannot establish growth or shrinkage. Slow traffic seen in both checks does not prove it was continuous between them.

    Only the current reading and a small comparison summary remain in this tab’s memory; reload or sign-out clears them. Traffic is not archived to GitHub or a database. A permanent archive needs a separate agreement: TomTom’s standard terms (§11.4 and §11.6.1) restrict storing results and derived traffic histories. GitHub hosts the app, public station locations and OSM approach geometry; the server retains only refresh counts and times.

    Privacy, sources & terms

    Owner sign-in is shared with Bali Cinema Map on this GitHub Pages origin. Signing out revokes this device session for both apps. Traffic is held in memory, not browser storage.

    Your location is requested only through “Show stations near me” and stays in this page. TomTom receives fixed map tile coordinates around selected stations. Google Maps links open the place without sending your current location.

    Traffic: © TomTom. Basemap: OpenFreeMap / OpenStreetMap. Expanded station locations: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. The original five station listings came from Google Maps.
